authorization_basis: Root-directed H230 full-data parent-to-student-pair endpoint recipe.
This packet freezes science and exact worker commands only; parent checkpoint identity, realized cache metadata and fresh resource admission remain blocking dependencies.

scope.purpose: Train an own all-supplied-data GRU256 student pair from the newly fitted own all-data parent using the four-family source-sum distillation cache.
scope.fit_membership: Every supplied train and valid target group exactly once per epoch; exposed validation groups are included.
scope.member_independence_note: Students use seeds3 and4 for separate training order/dropout randomness but share the same seed3 all-data parent checkpoint and identical teacher cache; do not claim independently initialized members.
scope.teacher_history_limit: Current teacher family fits use clean fold0 membership; all-data student fitting includes groups outside those teacher-fit populations. This is a declared heterogeneous-teacher analogue, not a full-data-teacher reference replication. Queue a separate own all-data heterogeneous teacher cohort after this endpoint.

parent_dependency.required_checkpoint_policy: fixed zero-based epoch3 from the frozen four-epoch parent run.
parent_dependency.binding_rule: After successful terminal fit, root must verify run provenance, all-supplied membership, fixed epoch3, source ancestry and checkpoint bytes; a root-approved successor must bind the terminal receipt and model_ep3.pt SHA256 before cache/student admission.
parent_dependency.initialization_independence_note: Both students share this one own all-data parent; separate seeds do not make separate initializers.

source.source_relation_to_parent: Students use the sealed E529/H230 source-v3 all-data distillation snapshot. Parent retry3 was trained from sealed source-v2. The student trainer consumes only the fixed checkpoint state and validates its architecture/preprocessing; post-fit root review must confirm this cross-snapshot checkpoint compatibility.
source.source_independence: Project-owned implementation and weights; no teammate code or model weights.

cache_membership.membership_gate: all supplied train and valid groups exactly once; cache row order must equal current target-index order; no fill/sort/positional fallback.

teacher_cache_dependency.main_target: source variant: unnormalized weighted sum of the eight teacher predictions (coefficient sum0.8125).
teacher_cache_dependency.family_targets: Mean raw predictions per family in declared family order; each family's own pair is averaged; no clip2.
teacher_cache_dependency.resource_status: No measured exact all-data cache profile; use existing packet's reviewed profile blocker and fresh root admission after parent fit. Do not infer 2GB from chunk arithmetic.

recipe.family_loss: Equal four-family weighted-MSE heads with raw per-family mean teacher targets.
recipe.throughput_mode: --fast; zero loader workers; source fast mode uses verified pinned/prefetch/fused optimizer/propensity-cache path.
recipe.student_pair_ancestry: Both train from the same parent ep3 and same all-data teacher cache. Pair-member seed changes control training randomness only.

data.fresh_launch_requires: Recheck file/stat bindings against the current source before cache materialization and student admission; do not read/re-hash full Parquet during this recipe freeze.

resource_request.resource_basis: Closest completed H230 batch16/chunk2000 family student and family-off control used 9,000,000,000-byte worker reservations; both peaked at8,999,997,440 bytes with zero worker OOM/kill. This is a proposed measured bound, not a fit authorization.
resource_request.controller: scripts/bandit_resources.py launch; one GPU lock; parent CPU cap and RAM headroom must be measured afresh after cache build; root admission required.
resource_request.current_slice_policy: Preserve corrected live CPU policy, memory.high18GB, memory.max20GB, swap0 and one-GPU-worker ceiling; no limit increases in this packet.

runtime_estimate.all_data_batch_scale: 779/746 = 1.0442359, based on observed all-data parent outer batches per epoch versus clean-fold student fits.
runtime_estimate.estimate_limit: Linear row-count scaling is a planning estimate, not observed all-data student throughput; no cache-build or export time included.

cache_build_budget.note: Comparable cache was clean-fold and chunk size2; it does not establish all-data chunk-size1 memory or runtime.

Verify fixed model_ep1.pt and model.pt match selected fixed epoch and provenance hashes.
Require training history epochs0 and1 only, both with evaluation withheld; training_state.pt present.

Make no heldout score claim; independent grader/root owns any later prediction comparison.
launch_preconditions: Retry3 parent fit succeeds; root binds terminal receipt and model_ep3.pt SHA256 in a reviewed successor.
The existing full-membership teacher cache contract completes under a separately root-admitted resource budget; validate exact eight arrays and realized metadata before training.
Fresh Parquet/input identity and row-group membership checks pass for both cache and each student launch.
Root reviews source-v2 parent to source-v3 student checkpoint compatibility and approves the exact successor contract.
Fresh current aggregate CPU/RAM/swap/VRAM admission passes for seed3, then separately for seed4; no concurrent local GPU worker.
Use a successor contract with realized cache metadata hash, source hashes, parent hash and current controller guard before launching; this V1 packet is not launch authority.
failure_policy: Preserve every terminal attempt, receipt, log, checkpoint and state file. Infrastructure failure is not negative scientific evidence. Any retry requires a new run/attempt ID and root-reviewed contract; no silent seed, parent, cache, epoch, recipe or checkpoint substitution.
